dek: Tufa’s lead is just 0.84 points. Ravi Teja Chilakala and Lashen Learning have reached the top ten, while much bigger jumps reshape the field below.

headline: Tufa leads Yi-Chia Chen by under a point as two new faces reach ARC-2’s top ten

image.caption: Score panel: Nov 1, 2026 · 7:56 PM EST; provisional public standings.

sections.heading: New faces at the summit
sections.text: Two weeks ago, Ravi Teja Chilakala stood 38th in ARC-2 and Lashen Learning was 25th. At Sunday’s 7:56 p.m. EST check, they were eighth and tenth. Between them sits V | A | M, up from 28th to ninth. Three teams have given the top ten a new look.

sections.heading: Less than a point at the front
sections.text: Tufa Labs holds the lead on 88.06. Yi-Chia Chen is right behind on 87.22: a gap of just 0.84. Yi-Chia Chen leads ARC-3, while Tufa has the upper hand here. Behind them, nvbanana’s 83.89 puts it third, only 0.42 ahead of Domdolus Tolus. There is precious little breathing room at either end of that leading quartet.

sections.heading: From deep in the field
sections.text: After NVARC3’s early-morning move on ARC-3, ARC-2 supplied its own afternoon drama. Keyser Soze climbed 1,844 places, from 1,910th to 66th, and stood 67th on 49.17 at 7:56 p.m. EST. areno moved from 995th to 59th, adding 22.22 points to reach 53.19. Together those jumps gained more than 2,700 places. Giovanny Rodríguez rose from 61st to 49th with another 6.52 points.

sections.heading: A crowded gold line
sections.text: S & M & N & S & Y jumped from 33rd to 15th after gaining eight points. Its 75.14 now matches the scores in 13th and 14th. Below that cluster, ảc holds 16th and ARCane occupies the final public gold place, 17th, on 73.89. artificialagencylab.com is next, just 0.70 points away.

sections.heading: Fourteen days that changed the race
sections.text: ARCane has more than doubled its score in two weeks, putting it on the public gold line.

sections.heading: The clock is running
sections.text: Watch Tufa’s narrow lead over Yi-Chia Chen, the new top-ten contenders and ARCane’s hold on the public gold line. Submissions close Monday, November 2, at 23:59 UTC—6:59 p.m. Eastern.
